svg.aria-label: Four connected questions: A is a simplified number–time model; B shows identical signals from half the cells with twice the per-cell activity; C compares three independently constructed experiments with common-blank-only analysis; D shows day means with between-day sample SD (n=3). Zero dose participates in analysis but is not plotted on the logarithmic axis.
